messages:
maria: Heads-up: planning a minor SDK change to surface client-side throttling info as headers. Want to sync on console metrics/rollout.
aj: what's the header name and format?
maria: thinking `X-Redwood-Rate-Limit: 120;window=60` and `X-Redwood-Rate-Remaining: 45`. Also a `X-Redwood-Rate-Scope: user|tenant`
sam: ugh headers in SDK will break some client proxies, any fallback?
maria: yeah we can send them only when `enableRateHeaders=true` in SDK (default off). Also emit a telemetry event so console can ingest reliably.
iris: console needs stable metric keys — don't want both `rate_remaining` and `rateRemaining` variants. Can we canonicalize?
aj: +1 on canonical names. console expects `rate_remaining` snake_case. we'll need a mapper in the ingestion layer.
console-bot: NOTE: dashboard ingestion expects metric.name = `sdk.rate.remaining` — if you change, add a compatibility metric and a migration note.
sam: for Python/TS/Go parity — I'll add header+telemetry in Go lib today, but TS middleware on edge sometimes strips unknown headers on Node proxies (we should document).
maria: possible approach: SDK emits a telemetry event `client.rate_info` with structured fields (rate, window, scope, remaining). Console can rely on telemetry for the canonical metric while headers remain an optional transport.
iris: telemetry event would be great — easier to version and sample. But we must ensure sampling flags so it doesn't blow up ingest.
aj: agree, sample at 0.1% by default, allow 100% for enterprise tenants via tenant config in console.
sam: note: telemetry event schema needs to be added to sdks/schema v2 before release. Also tests for proxy passthrough.
maria: action items: 1) sam: PR Go/py/ts header + `client.rate_info` telemetry (add schema); 2) aj: update console ingestion mapping to accept `client.rate_info` and create fallback mapping from headers; 3) iris: add sampling knob and retention estimate to pipeline; 4) maria: write RFC with header/telemetry schema + deprecation plan.
aj: timeline?
maria: aim to ship opt-in beta in two weeks, default off for stable release a month after beta if no major issues.
iris: will coordinate with infra for retention/ingest cost by EOD tomorrow.
console-bot: Deploy canary scheduled: 6198800000 — tagging related ingestion changes.
maria: thanks all. I'll open the RFC/PRs and ping this thread when drafts are ready. :thumbsup:
__note: Single-thread Slack export style: messages is a single continuous string with sender prefixes. All fields are strings or lists of strings per agents.md schema.
